title: The Moors in Spain
summary: A readable one-volume history of Muslim Spain from the conquest of 711 to the fall of Granada in 1492, by the orientalist Stanley Lane-Poole. It covers the Umayyad emirate and caliphate of Cordoba, the city's libraries and scholars, the Almoravids and Almohads, and the Nasrids of Granada. Public domain; the author died in 1931.
